steps: narrow it to one path with git log -n 20 --oneline -- PATH
open one commit with git show --stat REV, never the whole log
Grep the lockfile for the package name with -n
Read only those lines with offset and limit
for the installed version run jq -r .version node_modules/PKG/package.json instead
use Glob with one pattern for the files you need
narrow to the folder you care about before listing
